d455f6ca7132.zh: - 失败模式三分类表（内部工单，预登记判据：完成／F1 无效步≥一半／F2 位移<0.40 m／F3 其余）见 `audits/first-issue-due-diligence/failure-modes-<run>.md`；读法（补丁15 脚注）：0.40 m 判据与单步位移同量级（单步 `forward_m`＝0.20 m，阈值恰为两步），`traveled_m`（含第 0 步）与日志位姿累加两种口径相差约一步，有少数回合两口径判断相反，一律按预登记口径计入 F3，表不改；替代口径下的各家计数列在该表脚注，与 (a) 动作解析对照的矛盾核对随 (a) 回执交。
d455f6ca7132.en: - The three-class failure-mode table (internal work order Patch 13, pre-registered criteria: completed / F1 invalid steps ≥ half / F2 displacement < 0.40 m / F3 everything else) is in `audits/first-issue-due-diligence/failure-modes-<run>.md`; reading note (Patch 15 footnote): the 0.40 m criterion is of the same order as a single-step displacement (one step `forward_m` = 0.20 m, so the threshold is exactly two steps); `traveled_m` (including step 0) and the sum of logged pose increments differ by about one step, and in a few episodes the two measures give opposite verdicts — these are all counted as F3 under the pre-registered measure and the table is not changed; the per-model counts under the alternative measure are in that table's footnote, and the cross-check against the (a) action-parsing comparison is delivered with the (a) receipt.
